findings.problem: The build filter uses hasOwnProperty, which includes non-enumerable own properties, despite the contract requiring modules to be own enumerable keys of current.
findings.acceptance: Filter build modules by enumerable own membership in current, such as Object.keys(current), while preserving sorting and input immutability.
